article.headline: Ron Jessamy scores 15 as Texas State beats Southern Mississippi 85-65
article.description: — Ron Jessamy's 15 points off of the bench helped Texas State to an 85-65 victory over Southern Mississippi on Friday night.
article.linkText: Ron Jessamy scores 15 as Texas State beats Southern Mississippi 85-65

categories.description: Southern Miss Golden Eagles @ Texas State Bobcats

event.description: Southern Miss Golden Eagles @ Texas State Bobcats

keywords: Southern Miss Golden Eagles @ Texas State Bobcats
article.story: SAN MARCOS, Texas -- — Ron Jessamy's 15 points off of the bench helped Texas State to an 85-65 victory over Southern Mississippi on Friday night. Jessamy shot 6 of 6 from the field and 3 for 3 from the line for the Bobcats (4-0). Paul Djobet and K.J. Younger both scored 12. Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt finished with 17 points and two steals for the Golden Eagles (2-2). Southern Miss also got 13 points from Anthony Igiede. Texas State took the lead for good with 8:43 remaining in the first half. The score was 44-37 at halftime, with Jessamy racking up 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
